caption: The drawing depicts a single large ceramic jug positioned upright in the center of the composition, contained within a rectangular border on a plain beige background. The jug is bulbous in shape, tapering towards the base, and features a narrow neck with a small mouth and a curved handle attached from the mid-neck to the upper shoulder. The color of the jug is predominantly brown with variations in tone, including lighter and darker ochre patches, and some greenish and whitish highlights indicating reflections or texture. On the upper left side of the jug, there are blue decorative elements and faint pattern details. In the upper left corner of the image, inside the bordered area, there is a rectangular white label with the name "J. FENTON" written in bold black letters. The name "JOHN DANA" is written in small, thin letters in the bottom left corner within the border. The background outside of the jug remains plain and unadorned, consistently beige.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
